subject: Tomorrow is Lahiri Mahasaya's Birthday – Honor with Luca
body:
Tomorrow we honor the birthday of Lahiri Mahasaya, the great householder yogi who revived the ancient science of Kriya Yoga and passed it down through the line of gurus to Master.

Lahiri Mahasaya demonstrated that it is possible to achieve the highest spiritual realization while living a normal householder life. He showed that Kriya Yoga can be practiced by anyone, regardless of their circumstances, and that God-realization is accessible to all sincere seekers.

As we honor this great master, let us reflect on the accessibility of the spiritual path and the power of Kriya Yoga.

Here are some questions to explore with Luca:
{{exampleQuestions}}

May this day deepen your understanding of Kriya Yoga and its universal accessibility.

In divine friendship,
The Luca Team
